content.what_it_is: MATLAB script for the FUNWAVE-TVD tide_frf_abc_data case that plots surface-elevation time series from 13 gauge station files in a 5x3 subplot grid and exports jpg/eps. For k=1..13 (L7, L17): builds the file name sta_<4-digit fnum> (L21, L24), loads the ASCII station file (L26) whose column 1 is time and column 2 is eta (L31), replaces zero values with NaN via sta(sta(:,2)==0)=NaN (L28), plots eta vs time in subplot(5,3,k) (L30-L31), annotates 'G <k>' at (21000, 3.0) (L32-L33), applies grid and fixed axis [0 24000 -1 3.5] (L34-L35), and adds ylabel eta only on the left column (k=1,4,7,10,13) and xlabel 'time (s)' only on the bottom row (k=11,12,13) (L37-L42). Finally prints plots_movies/time_ser.jpg and time_ser.eps (L45-L46).
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
sta — station time series array, later reused as label string (L26, L32)

5x3 grid of eta(t) time series for stations G1..G13

unresolved: sta(sta(:,2)==0)=NaN (L28) uses the column-2 zero mask as linear indices into the whole matrix, so it NaNs entries in column 1 (time) at the corresponding linear positions rather than the intended eta values in column 2 — a latent indexing bug unless the file is single-column-of-interest.
The variable sta is overwritten from the data matrix to the label string inside the loop (L26 vs L32); harmless only because the data is reloaded each iteration.
Station files use 4-digit padding sta_0001 (L21) unlike the 5-digit field snapshots elsewhere; the FUNWAVE-TVD station output naming convention is assumed, not shown here.
Whether the G <k> label numbering matches the physical FRF gauge numbers or the reversed numbering used in plot_bathy_stations.m is not determinable from this file.
